definitions.gloss: self-destruction; self-ruin; bringing about one's own downfall
definitions.explanation: Destroying oneself or ruining one's own position through one's own actions or mistakes, rather than being defeated by an external force.

examples.japanese: {相手|あいて}の{自滅|じめつ}を{待|ま}つ。
examples.english: I'll wait for my opponent to self-destruct.

examples.japanese: ミスが{続|つづ}いて{自滅|じめつ}してしまった。
examples.english: A string of mistakes led to my own downfall.

examples.japanese: {自滅|じめつ}{的|てき}な{行動|こうどう}を{取|と}らないように、{冷静|れいせい}に{判断|はんだん}することが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's important to make calm decisions so as not to take self-destructive actions.

notes: Used as both a noun and a suru-verb ({自滅|じめつ}する). Frequently used in sports, games, business, and politics to describe losing not because the opponent was better, but because of one's own errors. Common expressions include {自滅|じめつ}する (to self-destruct), {自滅|じめつ}{的|てき} (self-destructive), and {相手|あいて}の{自滅|じめつ} (the opponent's self-destruction). Differs from {自殺|じさつ} (suicide), which is literal.
